AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Tools and Materials.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Tools and Materials.
